remarks: Welcome to this absolutely charming, lovingly maintained, single-family home. The house features a bright, spacious kitchen and dining area with two sliding doors to the garden, a comfortable living room with high windows that provide natural light and privacy, two bedrooms, step in closet, indoor laundry, and a timeless bathroom with white tile and dark slate flooring, while hardwood floors extend throughout the rest of the home. Outside, mature trees anchor the versatile wraparound garden which offers a low-maintenance, water-wise design or a blank canvas to reimagine.
